recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The seed issue has been fully superseded/applied in current source, and adding new source text would duplicate or conflict with later published Patient Care decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-23008 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care technical correction asking that AllergyIntolerance ait-1/ait-2 and Condition con-3 be rewritten because verificationStatus had become CodeableConcept while the invariants still treated it as a primitive code.
initial_application: Commit a233ae44884fd822d0d3500d76d39b9c9ed93bc2 applied the original fix by changing ait-1, ait-2, and con-3 FHIRPath/XPath expressions to inspect verificationStatus.coding system/code values. The Jira comments record the issue as a duplicate of GForge 22985 and 22986 and later point to FHIR-22973 for overlapping Condition work.
additional_context: Later published decisions changed the relevant conformance rules. FHIR-25514 removed AllergyIntolerance ait-1 and added guidance for negated allergy records; FHIR-28458 removed/refined refuted-status constraints and guidance; FHIR-29409 made Condition.clinicalStatus 1..1, removed the old verificationStatus/category-dependent con-3, and loosened Condition.category. Zulip and Confluence searches found community context that aligns with those Jira decisions and no conflicting FHIR-23008 evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/fhir.ini lists AllergyIntolerance and Condition as active resources; current AllergyIntolerance has guidance rather than ait-1/ait-2 constraints; current Condition has no verificationStatus-dependent con-3 and clinicalStatus is 1..1. A targeted source search found no old primitive-code invariant patterns in the current active source.
